read.title: How to Reply to Comments and DMs
read.text:
This guide is for everyone who manages our Instagram and TikTok accounts.

Reply to comments within 12 hours and to direct messages within 24 hours. Start with a friendly line such as 'Thanks for reaching out!' and use the follower's name when you can.

If many people ask the same question, add the answer as a pinned comment. For order problems, never share personal details in public. Ask the person to send a DM instead.

Do not delete negative comments unless they include rude language or spam. A calm, honest reply builds more trust than silence.
